disposition_reason: Table 1 reports Cu, Pb, Zn and Mn means (triplicate) and Cd below detection for one cocoa powder, one cocoa butter and one chocolate milk from a Nairobi supermarket.

study.design: small market survey of cocoa products
study.market: one supermarket chain branch, Nairobi County, Kenya
study.method: flame AAS (Shimadzu AA-6300) after aqua regia type wet digestion (7 mL HNO3 + 21 mL HCl) on hot plate
study.qa: deionized water blank only; no CRM or recovery
